review_policy.hypothesis: Finite accepted-wording variants may reject source-supported complete answers.
review_policy.decision_rule: Classify each wording-rejected training answer against its question and submitted source evidence; propose aliases only for complete supported claims. Keep uncertain/incorrect/incomplete answers excluded. Do not change active reward keys or use locked evaluation. Estimate effects on mixed groups with all existing inspection/support checks still enforced.
review_policy.reviewer_identity: Codex assistant; exact serving model ID not exported

interpretation: Fixed saved outputs rescored with proposed finite aliases, not a rerun of policy behavior and not evidence of learned improvement. Model-assisted training-data review, not human gold.
